name: Belladonna
source:
Life has been an endless cycle of heartbreaks and false hope, but maybe - just maybe - tonight will be different.

[From [url=https://buttoncupcake.itch.io/belladonna]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生活仿佛无尽循环，只有心碎与虚假的希望。但也许……真的也许，今晚会有所不同。

[来源：[url=https://buttoncupcake.itch.io/belladonna]Itch.io[/url]]
